description: Implementation of network logging functionality including socket management, threading, and data buffering for the starboard platform.

classes.name: FunctionThread
classes.description: A thread class that runs a provided function.

classes.name: BufferedSocketWriter
classes.description: Handles buffering and writing data to a socket with flow control.

classes.name: SocketListener
classes.description: Listens for incoming socket connections and invokes a callback.

classes.name: NetLogServer
classes.description: Singleton server managing network log connections and data transmission.

classes.name: ScopeGuard
classes.description: Prevents re-entrant logging behavior within a scope.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts SbSocketError enum to string.

methods.name: CreateListenSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket for listening.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main execution loop for FunctionThread.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer, dropping oldest if full.

methods.name: WaitUntilWritableOrConnectionReset
methods.description: Waits until socket is writable or connection resets.

methods.name: IsConnectionReset
methods.description: Checks if socket error indicates connection reset.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Attempts to send buffered data over socket.

methods.name: blocked_counts
methods.description: Returns number of times write was blocked.

methods.name: TransferData
methods.description: Transfers data from buffer to a string for sending.

methods.name: PrependData
methods.description: Prepends data to the buffer.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop for SocketListener to accept connections.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of NetLogServer.

methods.name: ListenForClient
methods.description: Sets up socket to listen for incoming client.

methods.name: OnClientConnect
methods.description: Handles new client connection.

methods.name: HasClientConnected
methods.description: Checks if a client is connected.

methods.name: OnLog
methods.description: Handles log message by buffering and signaling writer thread.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes server, socket connections, and flushes data.

methods.name: WriterTask
methods.description: Thread loop to send buffered data to client.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets thread-local boolean value.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Gets thread-local boolean value.
